subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the following sentence.**

My parents **__had not call__** me yesterday.
solution:
The correct answer is **"did not call."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the uniformity of the tenses.
 
• The sentence is in the past tense, so the correct verb form is the past simple.
 
• **"Had not call"** is the present perfect tense.
 
• **"Did not call"** is the correct past simple form of **"not call."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

**Correct sentence**: *My parents **did not call**__ me yesterday.*
